preservedPairs.reason: Divine Beings also supports posts about Greco-Roman religion, Christology, Gnosticism, and other contexts; the topic is intentionally limited to the Hebrew Bible and ancient Jewish traditions.
Debates includes classroom exercises and sustained scholarly disputes, whereas Public Debates is reserved for public debate events, announcements, rebuttals, and related exchanges.

Textual Criticism is the broader field and can materially support posts on manuscripts, variants, and scribal change; the topic requires sustained attention to the methods used to evaluate readings and reconstruct texts.
